limitations: Generated controls only; no OCR, semantic understanding, real host capture or input execution.
Binary contrast loses color/texture identity and may confuse different controls.
Explicit scales, stride alignment and local contrast limits bound support.
Overlapping controls and unseen scales/themes need broader testing.

protocol.scope: generated glyphs only; held-out designs still share renderer and are not external application validation
protocol.selection: Fixed before first execution; no training, threshold search or model selection

localization.scope: one candidate per named template; ambiguous inputs require abstention; execution errors count as missed unique targets
